newsitem.title: UK: Moody's puts Investicni Banka on review.
newsitem.headline: Moody's puts Investicni Banka on review.

text.p: Moody's said on Thursday it had placed under review -- with direction uncertain -- Investicni a Postovni Banka's rating of Baa2 for long-term deposits and the Prime-2 rating of the bank for short-term deposits.
It said in a statement it confirmed the bank's financial strength rating of D.

The decision on the deposit rating followed an announcement that the Czech government plans to sell to Nomura Securities Company an approximately 36 percent stake in the bank now held by two state-owned entities -- the National Property Fund and the Czech Post Office.
Nomura planned to inject additional equity capital in Investicni, eventually increasing its stake beyond 50 percent, it said in a statement.
Details of the planned sale are being negotiated, and are subject to bank audits engaged by the selling and purchasing parties.
Moody's would review the implications of the possible change in ownership for the bank.
